questions.stem: Which one of the following is the therapeutic use of Histamine analogue?
questions.solutionHtml:
Vertigo
  • Betahistine It is an orally active, H1 selective histamine analogue, which is used to control vertigo in patients of Meniéré’s disease. It possibly acts by causing vasodilatation in the internal ear.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 178

questions.stem: The H3 receptor agonist exhibits all of the following actions EXCEPT:
questions.solutionHtml:
Increase in H1-mediated gastrin secretion

Explanation: < H3 receptor is an auto-receptor, Gi/Go-protein coupled. It decreases histamine release at Lung, spleen, skin, and gastric mucosa, So option B is incorrect.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 175

questions.stem: Among the following options, which is an active metabolite of hydroxyzine?
questions.solutionHtml:
Cetirizine

It is a metabolite of Hydroxyzine, Cetirizine is an antihistamine that reduces the natural chemical histamine in the body. Histamine can produce symptoms of sneezing, itching, watery eyes, and runny nose. It is used to treat cold or allergy symptoms such as sneezing, itching, watery eyes, or runny nose. Cetirizine is also used to treat itching and swelling caused by hives.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:182

questions.stem: A patient comes to you with allergic rhinitis and his work requires constant attention. Which of the following drugs would you prescribe him?
questions.solutionHtml:
Loratidine

Loratidine  belongs to a group of medicines called antihistamines. It is used in the treatment of various allergic conditions. It relieves symptoms like itching, swelling and rashes.

  • Loratidine is a second-generation antihistamine with no sedation effects, so this is preferred in persons requiring constant attention in their work like truck drivers.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 182

questions.stem: Which of the following antihistaminic drug is associated with polymorphic ventricular tachycardia?
questions.solutionHtml:
Terfenadine

Terfenadine and astemizole

  • Blocks cardiac delayed rectifier K+ channels
  • Thereby causing polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (torsades de pointes)


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 572
